text.p: Year 1996
(in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated)
Net per shr (guilders) 0.84 vs 2.73
Net profit 28.7 vs 92.4
Dividend (guilders) 0.42 vs 1.25
Turnover (billions) 3.87 vs 3.83
Operating profit 109.2 vs 151.3
Note - Full name is Otra NV.
Extraordinary items* charge 27.7 vs nil
Notes: Otra said the net extraordinary charge of 27.7
million guilders in 1996 was made up of charges of 41.7 million
for reorganisation costs in Germany and Britain plus
extraordinary income of 14.0 million from the sale of two
stakeholdings.
Otra said results in the Netherlands remained positive, but
in Germany and Finland profits were lower and in Great Britain
it had made a big loss.
Otra said it expected a turnaround of the situation in Great
Britain in 1997/1998.
